  <section class="pj-section">
    <div class="pj-section-header">
      <p class="pj-section-label">ReproStats Packages</p>
      <p class="pj-section-sub">
        Open-source R infrastructure for regulated and reproducible clinical workflows.

    <div class="pkg-grid">

      <!-- regulog -->
      <div class="pkg-card" style="--pkg-accent:#0e7a4f">
        <div class="pkg-card-top">
          <div class="pkg-card-name">regulog</div>
          <span class="pkg-status status-pending">CRAN pending</span>
        </div>
        <p class="pkg-card-line">Tamper-evident, hash-chained audit logging for R</p>
        <ul class="pkg-card-feats">
          <li>SHA-256 hash chain — any modification detectable by <code>verify_log()</code></li>
          <li>Electronic signatures per 21 CFR Part 11 §11.100/§11.200</li>
          <li>Auto-log all data I/O with <code>with_log()</code> — no code changes needed</li>
          <li>Shiny integration with per-session audit trails</li>
          <li>IQ/OQ/PQ qualification suite + Requirements Traceability Matrix</li>
        </ul>
        <div class="pkg-card-tags">
          <span class="pj-tag">21 CFR Part 11</span>
          <span class="pj-tag">EU Annex 11</span>
          <span class="pj-tag">Audit Trail</span>
          <span class="pj-tag">Shiny</span>
        </div>
        <div class="pkg-card-links">
          <a href="https://reprostats.org/regulog/" target="_blank" class="pkg-link-primary">Package site →</a>
          <a href="https://github.com/repro-stats/regulog" target="_blank" class="pkg-link-ghost">GitHub</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- lineager -->
      <div class="pkg-card" style="--pkg-accent:#0d9488">
        <div class="pkg-card-top">
          <div class="pkg-card-name">lineager</div>
          <span class="pkg-status status-dev">In development</span>
        </div>
        <p class="pkg-card-line">Row-level data provenance and exclusion tracking</p>
        <ul class="pkg-card-feats">
          <li>Tags every row with a unique lineage ID (<code>.__lid__</code>) that survives filters and joins</li>
          <li>Mandatory documented reasons for every row exclusion</li>
          <li><code>lg_trace()</code> — trace any subject across the complete pipeline</li>
          <li>CONSORT-style disposition tables with <code>lg_disposition()</code></li>
          <li>CDISC Reviewer's Guide-aligned HTML provenance reports</li>
        </ul>
        <div class="pkg-card-tags">
          <span class="pj-tag">CDISC ADaM</span>
          <span class="pj-tag">Data Provenance</span>
          <span class="pj-tag">Exclusion Tracking</span>
        </div>
        <div class="pkg-card-links">
          <a href="https://reprostats.org/lineager/" target="_blank" class="pkg-link-primary">Package site →</a>
          <a href="https://github.com/repro-stats/lineager" target="_blank" class="pkg-link-ghost">GitHub</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- reproducr -->
      <div class="pkg-card" style="--pkg-accent:#1a56db">
        <div class="pkg-card-top">
          <div class="pkg-card-name">reproducr</div>
          <span class="pkg-status status-cran">CRAN</span>
        </div>
        <p class="pkg-card-line">Behavioural reproducibility auditing for R analyses</p>
        <ul class="pkg-card-feats">
          <li>Detects silent breaking changes across package updates</li>
          <li>Flags stochastic code, missing seeds, and locale-sensitive operations</li>
          <li><code>certify()</code> / <code>check_drift()</code> — hash and monitor analytical outputs</li>
          <li>Pharma QC, academic, and minimal report formats via Quarto</li>
          <li>Works with or without <code>renv</code>; zero configuration</li>
        </ul>
        <div class="pkg-card-tags">
          <span class="pj-tag">Reproducibility</span>
          <span class="pj-tag">Audit</span>
          <span class="pj-tag">CI/CD</span>
          <span class="pj-tag">Pharma QC</span>
        </div>
        <div class="pkg-card-links">
          <a href="https://repro-stats.github.io/reproducr/" target="_blank" class="pkg-link-primary">Package site →</a>
          <a href="https://github.com/repro-stats/reproducr" target="_blank" class="pkg-link-ghost">GitHub</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- bayprior -->
      <div class="pkg-card" style="--pkg-accent:#7c3aed">
        <div class="pkg-card-top">
          <div class="pkg-card-name">bayprior</div>
          <span class="pkg-status status-cran">CRAN</span>
        </div>
        <p class="pkg-card-line">Bayesian prior elicitation for clinical trials</p>
        <ul class="pkg-card-feats">
          <li>SHELF roulette, quantile &amp; moment matching across 7 distribution families</li>
          <li>Linear &amp; logarithmic expert pooling with Bhattacharyya diagnostics</li>
          <li>Conflict diagnostics: Box p-value, surprise index, KL divergence</li>
          <li>Robust and power priors (Schmidli, Ibrahim–Chen)</li>
          <li>FDA/EMA-aligned regulatory reports via Quarto</li>
        </ul>
        <div class="pkg-card-tags">
          <span class="pj-tag">Bayesian Methods</span>
          <span class="pj-tag">Clinical Trials</span>
          <span class="pj-tag">FDA/EMA</span>
          <span class="pj-tag">Shiny</span>
        </div>
        <div class="pkg-card-links">
          <a href="https://npenn.shinyapps.io/bayprior/" target="_blank" class="pkg-link-primary">Live App →</a>
          <a href="https://ndohpenngit.github.io/bayprior/" target="_blank" class="pkg-link-ghost">Docs</a>
          <a href="https://github.com/ndohpenngit/bayprior" target="_blank" class="pkg-link-ghost">GitHub</a>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
